📦 **ArtGallery `8a3dcfa`** — art: add female boatswain, sailmaker and cook with original profiles

Add Rowenna Knotwell, Celine Windstitch and Bea Warmkettle as independent
white-background full-body portraits, matching the refined anime pixel style
of Astrid and Maren. Each original character has history, personality, duties,
strengths, weaknesses, motivation, recruitment story proposal and dialogue.

Preserve built-in image_gen masters without edits. Each card records the
complete actual prompt, both reference hashes, output hash and visual review.
Gallery build/check pass with all three new cards and images present.
These asset tasks cover portraits and profiles; game integration stays open
under TASK-1172. Browser file URL preview remains unavailable under URL policy;
no browser UI validation claimed. Self-reviewed; no second reviewer assigned.

Refs TASK-1172
Fixes TASK-1182
Fixes TASK-1183
Fixes TASK-1184

👥 參與者：@meadow
